correctness.rationale: All admissible ordered pairs equal 7*6=42, with 21 unordered enumerated in spectrum_21.csv. Explicit three quotient maps x+1/x, x-1/x, x^2 induce Klein-four H1 splitting into three elliptic factors, giving L_C(T)=product(1-t_i T+9T^2) and #C(F9)=10-sum(t_i). Independently implemented F9 arithmetic (a+3b, i^2=2) enumerated every one of the 42 coefficient pairs, reproduced five exact trace-triplet frequencies and all point counts. The 21-row source CSV agrees, and independent source verify_extensions.py models F9,F81,F729; no extrapolation to unbounded base fields.
